meaning:
κοιτών, -ῶνος, ὁ
(κοίτη = Att.., δωμότιον, see Kennedy, Sources, 40), [in LXX chiefly for חֶדֶר, 2Ki.4:7, Jol.2:16; I Est.3:3, al. ;]
a bed-chamber; ὁ ἐπὶ τοῦ κ., a chamberlain: Act.12:20.†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: Now Herod was very angry with the people of Tyre and Sidon. They came with one accord to him, and, having made Blastus, the king’s personal aide, their friend…
